description: Variation of Condition 1 of approved planning permission 1478/23: regularise the development as built, including the increase in height, depth and width of the building; alterations to materials and fenestrations; additional windows on south-west and north-west elevations; amendments at fifth floor and roof level comprising relocation of approved plant equipment from roof level to the basement; provision of a restaurant and sky bar with associated facilities, external terrace areas, a retractable glazed roof, sliding glazed doors, relocated air conditioning equipment and associated parapets, railings and safety enclosures; together with amended roof plans, elevations and sections to reflect the completed development and its current operation as an aparthotel (for further details refer to the Design Amendment Statement and drawings). (Summary).
